subject: Added two sharp trap rows to 06-preview-image.md, which your files.json owns
body:
Heads-up, not a request. MPI-626 (Head Swap + Draw It In tile re-cut) hit two sharp
traps while building the stills, and Fabio approved healing them in the playbook.
That file is listed in MPI-620/files.json, so this is the notice you are owed.

What changed in docs/playbooks/add-flow/06-preview-image.md:
  1. The "run it from the scratchpad" remedy said to pass NODE_PATH=<repo>/node_modules.
     That is a CommonJS resolver feature and ESM ignores it, so an .mjs still dies with
     ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND with the variable set. Replaced with the absolute file:// import,
     in both the prose block and the trap-table row.
  2. New trap row above the existing composite/extract one: resize ALSO runs before
     composite in the fixed pipeline, and that variant throws nothing - overlays paste at
     unscaled size and offset onto an already-resized base and the file writes cleanly at
     the right dimensions. Cost one rebuild here (seam marker at x=210 instead of x=448).

Additive only - two edits, no existing line removed or reordered, nothing touched in the
sections your Scribble work owns. If it collides with an edit you have in flight, take
yours; the same two facts are in ~/.claude/memory/tools/sharp.md and can be re-applied.
